gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Tenergy's TN480U 8-bay kit needs a 5 V / 2 A (10 W) USB supply that is not in the box. It charges each AA at only 500 mA, so a 2,800 mAh Premium PRO cell needs at least 5.6 hours per charge (2,800 ÷ 500), and the cart needs a matching 5 V / 2 A wall charger with a micro-USB cable to work the day it arrives.
standout_why: I compared against geekchamp (best-rechargeable-batteries-for-aa-and-aaa-devices-2026, cited), the IKEA STENKOL/LADDA page (cited), rottenwifi (the top result), and the cloudfront 'Best AA & AAA Battery Chargers' page (#1 in the second chat). geekchamp and rottenwifi list mAh, cycle and retention claims. They give no charger current, no USB input requirement and no charge-time arithmetic; their only charge times are Amazon Basics' '4 AA within 7 hours'. The IKEA page gives '4-8 hours' and no input spec. The cloudfront page comes closest: it says in general that 'with every slot full, each cell gets less current', and it notes that one other charger (the POWEROWL 8-bay) has 'no wall adapter in the box'. It reviews the Tenergy T9688, not the TN480U, and gives no 5 V / 2 A figure or mA-per-slot math. I could not read digitalcameraworld (the page came back truncated) or theconsumerlibrary (certificate error), so neither was checked. I scored 3 rather than 2 because the missing adapter adds a cart line, though cloudfront has a generic version of the same point for a different charger.
kit_items: charger + cells: Tenergy combo TN480U 8-bay charger + 8× Premium PRO AA 2,800 mAh (P/N 90732). Eight independent bays at 500 mA per AA. Cells rated for 1,200 cycles and 85% retention after one year. The box includes one micro-USB cable but no wall adapter.

USB power supply: Tenergy 18W Adaptive Wall + Car Charger kit (P/N 59088). Its 5 V 2 A output exactly meets the TN480U's 'Input: DC 5V 2A'. It ships with two 6 ft USB-to-micro-USB cables, so it connects to the charger's micro-USB input without buying anything else. Tenergy's USB-C PD 20W (P/N 59149, 5 V 3 A, $15.99) also meets the power figure, but it comes with no cable, and the page doesn't say what plug is on the far end of the combo's micro-USB cable.

findings.label: Charge current per slot
findings.value: 500 mA per AA slot, 250 mA per AAA slot
findings.source_title: Tenergy TN480U 8-Bay NiMH Battery LCD Display Fast Charger, Micro USB/Type C Input
findings.note: Spec lines quoted: 'Charge Rate: AA: 500mA', 'Charging Output: 8x AA 500mA, 8x AAA 250mA'. The page does not say whether 500 mA holds when all 8 bays are loaded.

findings.label: Required input
findings.value: DC 5 V 2 A (10 W) via micro-USB or USB-C, adapter not included
findings.source_title: Tenergy Combo TN480U + 8-Pack Premium Pro AA (P/N 90732)
findings.note: Page says 'Input: DC 5V 2A' and 'Micro-USB to AC power adapter is NOT included'. Package: 8 AA, 1 TN480U, 1 micro-USB cable, 1 manual. 5 V × 2 A = 10 W, so a 5 V / 1 A (5 W) phone cube supplies half the rated input.

findings.label: Minimum time to fill one AA
findings.source_title: Tenergy Premium PRO Rechargeable AA, 2800mAh NiMH, 8 Pack
findings.note: 2,800 mAh rated ÷ 500 mA per slot = 5.6 h at full current, before NiMH charge-efficiency overhead (not sourced). Tenergy publishes no charge time for this pair. For comparison, the IKEA STENKOL page states '4-8 hours' for 1,900 mAh LADDA.

findings.label: Capacity, retention, cycles
findings.value: 2,800 mAh rated; 85% retained after 1 year in storage; up to 1,200 cycles; ships 80% pre-charged
findings.source_title: Tenergy Premium PRO Rechargeable AA, 2800mAh NiMH, 8 Pack
findings.note: Maker claim. 2,800 × 0.85 = 2,380 mAh after a year on the shelf. 8-pack (P/N 10443) costs $21.99 alone, so the combo's charger costs about $21 extra ($42.99 − $21.99).

findings.label: 5 V output and cables
findings.value: 5 V 2 A / 9 V 2 A / 12 V 1.5 A (18 W max); 2× 6 ft USB-to-micro-USB cables included
findings.source_title: Tenergy 18W Fast USB Charger Combo Kit - Dual Wall & Car Fast Chargers with 2x 6ft Micro USB Charging Cables
findings.note: The 5 V 2 A output equals the TN480U's rated input. $19.99, in stock.
